# Current essays after the Halpern comparison

28 October 2026.

A5 and A6 remain unchanged version-3 primary candidates. A4 is now version 4, *Limits of Uniform Normality Filters in Actual Causation*, at 5,631 words excluding the bibliography. The book comparison narrowed its originality claim; it remains a reserve on importance and novelty. E3 remains withdrawn.

Read `Halpern-Originality-Review.pdf` for the source comparison, or `Three-Essays-Reading-Copy-v4.pdf` for that assessment followed by all three essays. The separate essay PDFs are `Holistic-Accuracy-v3.pdf`, `Free-Evidence-v3.pdf` and `Causation-v4.pdf`.

The Halpern source request is resolved. A separate source request for Xiao and Xiong (2026) remains open because the central definitions and proofs were not reliably retrieved.

This GitHub edition contains the manuscripts, source assessment and validation material. The complete downloadable edition supplied to the owner also contains matching methodology reports and the archive. Those reports and that archive are excluded from this GitHub update after automatic approval review blocked publication of the updated methodology report's detailed production-history disclosures. No such content is included indirectly in this snapshot. Earlier repository versions remain unchanged.

For any entry, use the separate anonymous essay and its matching methodology report from the downloadable edition. The combined reading copy is for review. No contest submission has been made.

The verification records describe the full generated reading set, including outputs provided separately. `MANIFEST.json` lists only files in this GitHub snapshot. The previous finite theorem checks were not rerun; only source, presentation and attribution changes were made.
